summary: Post-refactor (24 Apr 2026) commercial-flow validation: 21/21 backend pytest passed + full frontend e2e via Playwright. Clienti -> Articoli -> Listini -> DDT (auto-price) -> Fatture (aggregate) -> Sospesi (incassa) flow end-to-end working. Multi-tenant isolation verified. 14 legacy routes correctly redirect to /dashboard. No legacy MES/magazzino/manutenzione leakage in UI or KPI. Two minor spec/impl discrepancies surfaced, none blocking.

minor.issue: Numero fattura prefix is 'FT-YYYY-NNNNN' (billing.py line 91) but spec in review request states 'FAT-YYYY-NNNNN'. Decide and align spec/code.

DEMO tenant document persisted pre-refactor still has legacy keys limits.lotti_monthly and usage.lotti_this_month (no ddt_monthly/ddt_this_month). ensure_demo_tenant in seed.py does not migrate existing records. New registrations get correct ddt_this_month. Impact: Billing.jsx for admin@cleantec.it may read wrong/missing usage key, and quota bypass hides the issue. Fix: add one-shot migration in seed that $rename or $unset+$set lotti_* -> ddt_* on existing tenants.

action_items: Align invoice numbering: either change code to 'FAT-' or update the spec/doc to 'FT-' (currently 'FT-2026-00045').

Write a one-off seed migration that renames limits.lotti_monthly->ddt_monthly and usage.lotti_this_month->ddt_this_month on the pre-existing DEMO tenant document so /api/tenants/me returns the new shape consistently (new tenants already correct).
Optional: hide 'magazzino' keyword still inside usage/limits legacy fields from tenants/me response for DEMO.
critical_code_review_comments: seed.ensure_demo_tenant only creates new DEMO tenant; it does NOT migrate an existing one. After the 24 Apr refactor the DEMO tenant in DB still carries legacy lotti_* keys. Add explicit migration step.
require_roles() always implicitly allows 'admin' (core.py line 202-203). Good for convenience but means explicit allowlists in routers are somewhat misleading; document this behaviour.

enforce_quota() reads resource 'ddt_monthly' from tenant.limits. For any tenant whose limits still contain lotti_monthly (like DEMO), the lookup returns 0, which would block DDT creation if not for the is_demo bypass — risk if a non-demo pre-refactor tenant exists.
GET /api/sospesi returns an object {fatture: [...]} while many other list endpoints return a bare array. Inconsistent shape; consider standardising.
test_credentials: Uses /app/memory/test_credentials.md (admin@cleantec.it/admin123, logistica@cleantec.it/logistica123, contabilita@cleantec.it/contabilita123, super@cleantec.it/Superadmin123!) — all valid.
seed_data_creation: Tests rely on existing DEMO seed (5 clienti, 6 articoli, 2 listini, 6+ DDT). TestFatturazione creates a fresh DDT each run then invoices it (self-contained). TestRegistration creates a new tenant TEST_<random> in DB (not cleaned up) — consider periodic cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full commercial flow is green. If fixing the two minor items, re-run backend/tests/test_iter10_commercial.py and verify /api/tenants/me for admin@cleantec.it now exposes usage.ddt_this_month instead of lotti_this_month. Frontend is clean — only console 401s pre-login which are expected. DDT seq counter is now at ~16 because of prior test runs; this is fine.
rca_of_minor_issues: DEMO tenant was seeded before the MES->commercial refactor; seed.ensure_demo_tenant has an if-not-exists guard so the existing document is never re-shaped. Proper fix: after ensure_demo_tenant insert block, add an $unset/$set migration that converts lotti_* keys to ddt_* on the DEMO tenant doc (idempotent). Invoice prefix mismatch is pure spec vs code drift — billing.py line 91 hardcodes 'FT-'.
